entities.summary: Hwasan Lee clan is a Korean clan with Vietnamese origin. Their Bon-gwan is in Kumchon County, North Hwanghae Province. As of 2000, there are 1775 members of this clan. Their founder was Lee Yong-sang, a member of the Vietnamese imperial family of the Lý dynasty. He was exiled to Goryeo through the Song dynasty in 1226 when the Lý dynasty fell to the Trần dynasty.
